prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1484; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is entitled to compensation under the applicable policy.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including any requests for statements, recorded interviews, or settlement discussions, exclusively to this office. Do not contact our client directly.

We request that you provide written confirmation of the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with the declarations page and any other applicable coverage information.

Please also ensure that all evidence relating to this collision is preserved. This includes vehicle data, photographs, dashcam or telematics records, repair estimates, claim file materials, witness statements, and any recorded communications. Destruction or alteration of such evidence may result in serious consequences for your company and your insured.

We look forward to your prompt response.
